{{Quote|Captain, we've spotted the remains of a Jedi starfighter ahead.|A B1 battle droid|<ref name="Bait" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''B1 battle droid captain''' commanded the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] personal [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while inside an [[Unidentified ice field/Legends|ice field]], the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] came across the damaged [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Jedi starfighter]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] ordered the [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|fighter]] and its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to be [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|captured]], and Skywalker was subsequently apprehended. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had planned his capture and disabled the security systems of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], which allowed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to infiltrate the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] unseen. As the Jedi confronted Dooku together, the frigate was ambushed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Pursued by the Jedi pair, Dooku was able to escape from the frigate, and the Captain was left to take care of the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're picking up one life-sign.''"<br />"''Tow it aboard and have a security detail standing ready!''"<br />"''Roger Roger.|A B1 battle droid and the Captain|<ref name="Bait" />}}
[[File:CountDookusFrigate-Bait.png|thumb|left|240px|Count Dooku's frigate]]
Created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="db" /> a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was in charge of the personal [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]].<ref name="Bait" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] was passing through an [[Unidentified ice field/Legends|ice field]] when a subordinate droid of the Captain spotted a heavily damaged [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Jedi starfighter]] nearby, which contained one life-sign aboard. Upon hearing the subordinate's report, the Captain ordered the [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] to be towed into the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] and sent a security detail, consisting of B1 and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]], to [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|restrain]] the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. The fighter was successfully captured and the Jedi, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], was quickly [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]].<ref name="Bait" />

Unbeknownst to the Captain, Skywalker had intentionally allowed himself to be captured<ref name="Bait" /> so that he could disable the frigate's security systems<ref name="Captured">''[[The Clone Wars: Captured]]''</ref> and allow fellow Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to infiltrate the frigate undetected. Soon after Skywalker's supposed capture, while the frigate was near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], Kenobi boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and freed Skywalker, after which the pair confronted Dooku together. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the frigate was ambushed and fired upon by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Chased by the Jedi, Dooku quickly fled from the outgunned frigate, leaving it<ref name="DookuCaptured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> and the Captain<ref name="Bait" /> to deal with the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]].<ref name="DookuCaptured" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|&hellip;those stupid battle droids will fall for ''anything''.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Bait" />}}
Like all B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the same [[B-series battle droid/Legends|series]], the droid Captain stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="db" /> The Captain was in command of [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku's frigate, and the droid crew of the ship called themselves "the best of their series," an outlook held because they served directly under the leader of the Confederacy. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Skywalker did not share their opinion&mdash;he believed the droids were so unintelligent that they would fall for the most simple of plans. Indeed, when the Captain heard about the Jedi's immobilized fighter, the droid ordered it to be captured, failing to realize that that was exactly what Skywalker wanted.<ref name="Bait" />

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid Captain first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], which led directly into "[[Dooku Captured]]," the eleventh episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Bait" />
